## Summary

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix

Before/After images or recordings.

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is based on `dev` and this PR targets `dev`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] Added/updated tests (if applicable)
- [ ] Updated docs / CHANGELOG `Unreleased` section (if applicable)
- [ ] Generated RibbonDiffXml verified (if ribbon output changed)
- [ ] No secrets included (tokens/keys)
- [ ] Accessibility considered (keyboard/nav/contrast)
